summary: Silver Point Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01. Under Item 3.02, the Fund issued 745,920 unregistered common shares at $26.80 per share for aggregate proceeds of ~$19.99M, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. Under Item 8.01, the Board declared a monthly dividend of $0.1575 per share, payable July 31, 2026. This is a routine capital raise and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No premium, deal terms, or strategic event are present. Watch for ongoing NAV and distribution consistency.
